ledger.title: Member passbook
ledger.caption: A sample page. Sign in to see your real balances.

modules.title: The whole samiti, in six parts
modules.intro: Everything that used to go into the paper ledger has its own place in the app.

items.title: Members and nominees
items.body: Member details, business, address and up to two nominees. Membership active, inactive, suspended or exited.

items.title: Amanot, share and fixed Amanot
items.body: Every deposit and withdrawal lands in the member's passbook. The app checks the withdrawal limit itself.

items.title: Loans and installments
items.body: Application, approval, disbursement and installment collection. The app works out interest and the schedule.

items.title: Cash, bank and samiti entries
items.body: Cash book, bank accounts, income and expense, assets and liabilities, and transfers between accounts.

items.title: Year-end
items.body: Service charge, depreciation, dividend and profit appropriation. Every step is previewed before it runs.

items.title: Reports
items.body: Receipts and payments, income and expenditure, balance sheet, trial balance and the dividend list. Printable.

year.title: One fiscal year, July to June
year.intro: The app follows the samiti's year. Each year-end step happens in order.

steps.title: A new year starts
steps.body: Member and samiti balances carry forward; income and expense start from zero.

steps.title: Deposits, withdrawals and loans
steps.body: The office records each transaction and the member sees it in their passbook right away.

steps.title: Service charge and depreciation
steps.body: The yearly charge comes out of Amanot. If the balance is short, the rest is taken from the next deposit.

steps.title: Dividend
steps.body: The committee's amount is shared among active members within the limits in settings.

steps.title: Profit appropriation and closing
steps.body: Net profit goes to the funds, and the old year's books are locked.

safeguards.title: Books that keep their own record

items.title: Nothing is erased
items.body: A wrong entry is reversed. The original and its reversal both stay in the ledger.

items.title: Closed years stay closed
items.body: Once a year is closed, nobody can add or reverse an entry dated in it.

items.title: Each role, its own rights
items.body: Super admin, admin and member can each do only what their role allows.

items.title: A name on every entry
items.body: Who recorded each entry, and when, is kept with the transaction.

items.title: Exact to the paisa
items.body: Every amount is kept in paisa. Nothing is rounded along the way.

items.title: Careful sign-in
items.body: You set your own password at first sign-in. Repeated wrong passwords pause sign-in for a while.

items.question: How do I become a member?
items.answer: Contact the samiti office. The office opens your membership and gives you a member number, and your sign-in account is created with it.

items.question: How do I sign in the first time?
items.answer: Use your member number and your registered mobile number as the first password. The app then asks you to set a new password.

items.question: What if I forget my password?
items.answer: Tell the office. When an admin resets it, your password becomes your mobile number again, and you set a new one after signing in.

items.question: Can I deposit money online?
items.answer: Not yet. Pay at the office as usual. The deposit shows in your passbook as soon as the office records it.

items.question: Who can see my account?
items.answer: You and the samiti office. Other members can't see your account.

items.question: How is the dividend decided?
items.answer: At year-end the committee sets the total. It is shared among active members by their Amanot and fixed Amanot, within the limits in settings, and added straight to their Amanot.
